blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte was handed a letter of authority (LOA) from the Bureau of Internal Revenue after she was flagged for receiving compensation from the Davao City government despite already occupying the country’s second-highest elective office. At Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, lawyer Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez, chief-of-staff of BIR Commissioner Charlito Mendoza, was quizzed by counsel for the prosecution, Erwin Matib, regarding a Form 2316 under the vice president’s name in 2023—which pertains to a certificate of compensation. When asked what the form contained, Garcia-Marquez confirmed that it was signed by employees of the city government of […]...
